instruction: Buy everything on my amazon wishlist, and have it delivered to my work address.
notes: Single-app (amazon) purchase task. The wish list contents are unknown a priori, so the problem assumes two wish-list products (wish-product-1/2); the agent issues one move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart call per entry returned by show_wish_list (moving without a quantity transfers the full wished quantity, and it deletes the WishListEntry as the evaluation requires). A discrete counter (count-2 -> count-1 -> count-0 via next-count) tracks remaining wish-list entries so place_order is only enabled once everything is in the cart; clear_cart is forced before any move (it can only run while (not (cart-cleared))) so the order contains exactly the wish-list products. show_addresses/show_payment_cards gate place_order, and place_order requires (is-work-address ?ad), ensuring delivery to the Work address without modifying addresses. Goal facts are grounded per product, so supervisor-complete-task's precondition uses (order-placed), which by construction of place_order's preconditions implies all other goal conditions; complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question.
